result.summary: The food-delivery home screen is mostly coherent, but one restaurant name is truncated mid-word and two adjacent carousel cards appear to be the same restaurant, which looks like a content or data-display bug.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title is cut off as “Smash Bros Bu”, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or truncate with an ellipsis after a complete word so the restaurant is identifiable.

issues.description: The first two “Fastest near you” cards show the same restaurant (Green Bowl Poké), same image, and same delivery fee, which looks like a duplicate listing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel is populated with distinct nearby restaurants or clearly differentiate branches if they are intentional duplicates.
